Tip.description:
The tip, built and tested, and measured beyond pass and fail; or `error` alone, where it could not be. An
environment's failure (kennet/check/codeval.py `tip_environment`) leaves the tip asked again; any other error ends the run.
Tip.title: Tip

description: What `kennet codeval` sends (kennet.codeval.profile.v1, kennet.codeval.results.v1) and the instructions it is answered with (Next). Closed: no field takes free text. What the results extract from running code and reading logs is capped at 500000 bits a step and 117000000 bits a measure, at most 6 measures a run (log2 of each field's domain, summed; hashes by x-bits, test keys as opaque ids, durations as buckets of x-bounds-ms). The cap bounds what the published client sends; a client the seller modifies and runs reveals only the seller's own data. The profile's git metadata is outside the cap: facts git already holds, not values extracted from content.
title: Kennet CodeVal
